title: ContextSummary
description: Four-layer context payload returned by an atom's contextSummary function. Provides prose, typed data, key metrics, and related atoms, plus history provenance and access policy.

prose.description: Human-readable prose summary suitable for AI prompt insertion.

typed.description: Atom-typed payload. Open structure allowing atom-specific fields.

keyMetrics.description: Compact key/value tiles surfaced in card and compact modes.

value.description: Metric value as string or number.

relatedAtoms.description: Other atoms this one references; used for crawl and chip rendering.

entityType.description: Entity type of the referenced atom.

entityId.description: Entity ID of the referenced atom.

displayLabel.description: Inline-prose display label. Presentation-only; never used for identity.

historyProvenance.description: Provenance of the latest history event. Always present; if no events yet, set latestEventId to empty string and latestEventAt to the atom's creation timestamp.

latestEventId.description: ID of the latest event, or empty string if no events exist.

latestEventAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the latest event.

scopeFiltered.description: True when the Scope object changed the resolved payload relative to the unscoped baseline.

accessPolicy.description: Per-instance access tier per ADR-017. Surfaces that gate on visibility treat an omitted field as the registration's accessPolicy default — or 'public-free' when the registration also omits it.
